hyperfine constants of excited levels other than 3s 2S1/2 (2s2p2 2D, 3p, 3d ...): none located; Milner & Milner 2025 state that the 2s2p2 2D5/2 hyperfine structure has not even been calculated
measured Lande g_J factors of B I levels: none located in an opened source

isotope shifts of lines other than 2P1/2-3s 2S1/2 (e.g. the 208.9/209.0 nm 2s22p-2s2p2 2D lines of Johansson et al. 1993, and 2P3/2-3s): Kramida & Ryabtsev, Phys. Scr. 76, 544 (2007) is paywalled; not recorded
absolute frequency of 2P3/2-3s 2S1/2 (249.85 nm) measured with laser spectroscopy: Renth et al. 2026 report no frequency value
laser cooling of atomic boron: no demonstration found; the 249.8 nm doublet is used for spectroscopy and (proposed) optical pumping only
measured transition probabilities newer than NIST (Fuhr & Wiese 2010 is the NIST source): none located
conflicts: lifetime of 2s2p2 2D (O'Brian & Lawler 1992): printed as 23.1 +- 1.2 ns in Fuhr & Wiese 2010 (Table 14) and as 23.1(2) ns in Lundberg et al. 2001 (Table IV); 1.2 ns kept (5%, in line with their other values)
2s24d 2D lifetime: 10.3(5) ns (Lundberg 2001) vs 10.0(5) ns (O'Brian & Lawler 1992), consistent; 2s23d 2D: LIF 4.7(2) ns vs beam-foil 3.9(5) ns; 2s2p2 2S: LIF 3.3(2) ns vs beam-foil 3.6(3) ns
10B-11B isotope shift of 2P1/2-3s: -5031.3(2.0) MHz (Maass et al. PRL 2019) vs -5032.3(22) MHz (difference of absolute frequencies, thesis) vs 5220(150) MHz magnitude (Johansson 1993)
2P1/2-3s 11B frequency: 1 200 359 033.9(14) MHz (Maass thesis) vs 1 200 358 689(90) MHz (Johansson et al. 1993), 3.8 sigma apart; 10B: 1 200 364 066.2(17) vs 1 200 363 905(120) MHz
notes: Isotope shifts are nu(10B) - nu(11B) (negative: the heavier isotope has the higher frequency). frequency_THz refers to 11B and frequency_THz_10 to 10B, both hyperfine centres of gravity. Lifetimes were measured for LS terms; the same value is entered for each fine-structure level of the term that the site draws. 'compilation' lifetimes are the O'Brian & Lawler 1992 laser-induced-fluorescence values as printed in NIST's Fuhr & Wiese 2010 compilation. Hyperfine: 11B I = 3/2 (mu = 2.688 648 9(10) mu_N), 10B I = 3 (mu = 1.800 644 78(6) mu_N) as quoted by Puchalski et al. 2015.
